violations.description: Refrigerated Storage. — --Freezer or cold storage was insufficient or ineffective at maintaining potentially hazardous food in a frozen state. 2 door upright freezer #15795 not maintaining items at proper freezer temperature.

General equipment and utensils - Maintenance and operation. — --Nonfood contact equipment/utensil was not maintained in a good repair or sound condition. Particle board cabinets in FOH prep area showing wear and have exposed wood surfaces and should be re-sealed.
Handwashing lavatories. — --Handwashing lavatory was not kept clean or maintained. Hand sink between upright freezers in FOH area has food debris build up and needs cleaning.

Handwashing lavatory supplies. — --Handwash lavatory was not supplied with supply of individual disposable towels, continuous towel supply system, or heated air-drying device. Paper towel dispenser empty at main kitchen hand sink.
Lighting. — --Existing light fixtures did not provide adequate illumination. Light fixture at hand sink and near fryers not working. Needs repair. Can light above reach in freezer #15803 not working.

Mechanical cleaning and sanitizing requirements. — --Surface of equipment/utensil did not reach minimum temperature of 160F during hot water sanitize rinse of ware wash machine. Dish machine maximum temperatures at 146 & 152 degrees F.

Date marking and disposition of ready-to-eat potentially hazardous food. — --Refrigerated, ready-to-eat potentially hazardous food (prepared more than 24 hours ago) was not properly date marked. Multiple containers and packages of food items in walk in cooler not provided with date marking.

General equipment and utensils - Maintenance and operation. — --Nonfood contact equipment/utensil was not maintained in a good repair or sound condition. FOH particle board showing wear/damage. No longer maintained sealed.
